head_commit.message:
chore: enusre the logic that creates ConfigLayerStack has access to cwd (#8353)

`load_config_layers_state()` should load config from a
`.codex/config.toml` in any folder between the `cwd` for a thread and
the project root. Though in order to do that,
`load_config_layers_state()` needs to know what the `cwd` is, so this PR
does the work to thread the `cwd` through for existing callsites.

A notable exception is the `/config` endpoint in app server for which a
`cwd` is not guaranteed to be associated with the query, so the `cwd`
param is `Option<AbsolutePathBuf>` to account for this case.

The logic to make use of the `cwd` will be done in a follow-up PR.

head_commit.message:
docs(tui2): document scroll update contract + terminal defaults

This is a docs-only follow-up for the stream-based mouse scrolling work:

- App integration: document `mouse_scroll_update` / `apply_scroll_update` / `handle_scroll_tick` / `transcript_scroll_dimensions`, including what `ScrollUpdate` returns (`lines` delta + `next_tick_in`) and how Draw ticks drive stream finalization and cadence-based flushing.
- Config docs: note the current macOS probe-derived `tui.scroll_events_per_tick` defaults for the 8 tested terminals (Terminal.app, Warp, WezTerm, Alacritty, Ghostty, iTerm2, VS Code terminal, Kitty) and call out that we should expand coverage to more terminals/platforms over time.

head_commit.message:
chore: enusre the logic that creates ConfigLayerStack has access to cwd (#8353)

`load_config_layers_state()` should load config from a
`.codex/config.toml` in any folder between the `cwd` for a thread and
the project root. Though in order to do that,
`load_config_layers_state()` needs to know what the `cwd` is, so this PR
does the work to thread the `cwd` through for existing callsites.

A notable exception is the `/config` endpoint in app server for which a
`cwd` is not guaranteed to be associated with the query, so the `cwd`
param is `Option<AbsolutePathBuf>` to account for this case.

The logic to make use of the `cwd` will be done in a follow-up PR.

chore: enusre the logic that creates ConfigLayerStack has access to cwd (#8353)

`load_config_layers_state()` should load config from a
`.codex/config.toml` in any folder between the `cwd` for a thread and
the project root. Though in order to do that,
`load_config_layers_state()` needs to know what the `cwd` is, so this PR
does the work to thread the `cwd` through for existing callsites.

A notable exception is the `/config` endpoint in app server for which a
`cwd` is not guaranteed to be associated with the query, so the `cwd`
param is `Option<AbsolutePathBuf>` to account for this case.

The logic to make use of the `cwd` will be done in a follow-up PR.
